name: Meander
description: Square rings sliding out from under each other, the way Ring's circles do.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { width: 70%; height: 70%; margin: 15%; :before { content: ''; position: absolute; width: 100%; height: 100%; left: @rand(-20%, 20%); top: @rand(-20%, 20%); border: calc(36px / @size-row) solid @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); box-sizing: border-box; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; width: 100%; height: 100%; border: calc(36px / @size-row) solid @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); box-sizing: border-box; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
